pages.title: Architecture
pages.body_storage:
Nimbus platform overview

Nimbus is a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard product. The board product (NMB), platform API (NMA), and support portal (NMS) share a single identity plane and workspace model.

Use the child pages below for system context, component maps, retention policy, and observability standards before opening a new design doc. Prefer linking open Jira keys when a diagram or decision constrains active work.

  • Board UI: Auth, Billing, Dashboard, Editor, Notifications
  • Platform: REST API, Webhooks, Workers, SDK, Rate Limiting
  • Support: Triage, Escalation, Billing Questions

Public reference stubs live at example.com/docs/platform.

pages.title: ADRs
pages.body_storage:
Architecture Decision Records

ADRs capture durable engineering choices. Each child page follows Status, Context, Decision, and Consequences so future readers can re-evaluate the trade-off without replaying chat history.

Link Jira keys when a decision unblocks or constrains active work. Review open ADRs during onboarding and before large refactors that touch workspace scope, webhooks, or the editor protocol.

Start from the shared template at ADR template and keep status accurate (Proposed / Accepted / Superseded).

pages.title: Runbooks
pages.body_storage:
Operations runbooks

On-call procedures for Nimbus production. Steps must be copy-pasteable; use placeholders instead of installation-specific hostnames or account ids.

Pager rotation and escalation contacts are maintained by Alex Kim in the ops calendar. Child pages cover webhook DLQ replay, rate-limit storms, SSO certificate rotation, worker lease exhaustion, billing PDF triage, and Sev-1 cross-tenant display response.

After any runbook change, dry-run the steps on staging and note the date in a page comment.

pages.title: Onboarding
pages.body_storage:
Engineering onboarding

New engineers should complete local setup, read security basics, then pair on a first ticket from the NMB or NMA backlog. Prefer customer-reported bugs with clear reproduction steps over greenfield stories in week one.

  1. Local Development Setup
  2. How We Ship (trains and definition of done)
  3. Security Basics for Engineers
  4. 한국어 온보딩 가이드 when Korean is preferred

Mentors default to Alex Kim. Ask in the eng channel if your first ticket is blocked on credentials or seed data.

pages.title: Release Notes
pages.body_storage:
Engineering release notes

Internal notes aligned with board fix versions 2026.6.0 through 2026.9.0 and platform releases v2.3–v2.5. Customer-facing copy lives in the PROD space under Release Comms.

Always list reopened bugs and regression-labeled issues that rode the train so support can cross-check customer reports against the real fix set.

Child pages cover 2026.7.0, 2026.8.0, and platform v2.5; keep them updated until the train ships, then freeze.

pages.title: Postmortems
pages.body_storage:
Incident postmortems

Blameless write-ups for production incidents. Prefer issues with reopen history as signals of incomplete fixes rather than one-off flukes.

Security and privacy incidents such as cross-tenant display escalate as Sev-1 regardless of customer count. Timeline, root cause, and action items are required; owner assignment is not optional.

Publish within five business days of mitigation. Link related runbooks when the fix changes on-call procedure.

pages.title: Engineering Meetings
pages.body_storage:
Meeting notes

Weekly eng sync and design reviews. Action items should carry issue keys when work is already filed in Jira so search and the scry mirror stay useful.

Publish notes the same day and tag Alex Kim for on-call relevant items so handoff is never oral-only. Design reviews need a clear approve / revise / reject outcome.

Child pages include recent syncs and the notification snooze design review.

pages.title: QA Playbooks
pages.body_storage:
QA playbooks

Repeatable scripts for regression suites covering performance, security, accessibility, and billing paths. Each case references concrete issue keys so failures map back to open work instead of free-text titles alone.

Run the dashboard, auth/SSO, billing, API/webhook, and editor suites before every board train cut. Smoke accessibility weekly even when no a11y-labeled tickets ship.

Update a playbook in the same PR that changes the UI contract it asserts.

pages.title: Product Home
pages.body_storage:
Nimbus product wiki

Specs, briefs, and release communications for the Nimbus dashboard suite. Engineering implementation tracks live in NMB for the board, NMA for the API and SDK, and NMS for the support portal.

Start from roadmap themes on this home tree, open a product brief for exploration, then promote to a full feature spec once capacity is committed.

Keep language free of real customer names; use example.com links only when linking out of Confluence.

pages.title: Feature Specs
pages.body_storage:
Feature specifications

Detailed specs for shipping features. Each child page should list open Jira keys, acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope notes so engineering and QA share one source of truth.

Korean specs sit alongside English ones to support bilingual search demos and dual-language stakeholders. Prefer short sections over long prose walls.

When a spec ships, leave a comment with the release train version and close or re-home open issue links.

pages.title: Product Briefs
pages.body_storage:
Product briefs

Lightweight problem framing before full specs. Use briefs for exploration, prioritization, and cross-team alignment when the solution shape is still open.

Promote a brief to a Feature Spec once engineering capacity is committed for the quarter. Briefs that stall more than two cycles should be archived with a one-line reason.

Link support themes from Customer Research when the problem originated in CSAT or ticket volume.

pages.title: Release Comms
pages.body_storage:
Release communications

Customer-facing and internal release narratives tied to 2026.x board trains, platform v2.x, and support Sprint 41–43.

Coordinate with ENG internal notes so issue keys stay consistent across spaces. Legal review is required for billing and tax wording before customer publish.

Child pages cover board 2026.7.0 and 2026.8.0, platform v2.5, and Sprint 43 support highlights.

pages.title: Product Meetings
pages.body_storage:
Product meeting notes

Roadmap reviews and cross-functional syncs with engineering and support. Decisions should cite issue keys for traceability in scry search and the local mirror.

Keep notes bilingual-friendly when Korean stakeholders attend: either dual sections or a short Korean summary under the English body.

Default note owner rotates; Alex Kim covers eng-facing action items when product is out.

pages.title: Customer Research
pages.body_storage:
Customer research notes

Anonymized themes from support tickets and CSAT. No real customer names, domains, or contact details—use example.com only if you need an outbound link.

Themes feed product briefs and feature specs. Link related Jira keys when defects already exist so engineering can estimate against known work.

Refresh each research note at least quarterly; stale themes mislead prioritization.

pages.title: System Context Diagram
pages.body_storage:
Context

Nimbus clients—the web board, support portal, and public SDK—talk to the edge API, which routes to workers and webhook fan-out. Shared identity means SSO defects on the board often share root causes with portal-only failures.

Mixed-case NameID handling on the board is tracked in NMB-137; portal subdomain SSO failures live in NMS-112. Treat them as one IdP configuration path during incidents.

Trust boundaries

  • Browser sessions sit in the Auth component; silent token renewal and cookie refresh are covered by NMB-107.
  • OAuth deep links must land on the board, not the root dashboard—see NMB-122.
  • Tenant isolation regressions such as NMS-134 are Sev-1 even if the flash is brief.

Diagram source: context.svg. Update the SVG when a new external client is added.

comments.body_storage: Alex Kim: Keep the edge versus worker boundary explicit—on-call mixed them up during the last rate-limit incident.

pages.title: Component Map — Board Product
pages.body_storage:
Components

The board product splits into Auth, Billing, Dashboard, Editor, and Notifications. Cross-component bugs usually hide in shared chip or toast primitives.

Hot spots this quarter

  • Filter chips resetting after a workspace switch: NMB-104.
  • Chart legend overlap at 1280px viewports: NMB-105.
  • Notification toasts stacking under the sticky editor toolbar: NMB-108.
  • Editor autosave writing the previous revision every third save: NMB-109.
  • Workspace switcher showing a stale plan tier until full reload: NMB-110.

Dashboard layout work for 2026.8.0 must not regress heatmap rendering under forced colors; that path is NMB-121.

Collaborative protocol documentation for SDK consumers is NMB-174; initial-paint performance budgets for mid-tier laptops are NMB-181.

pages.title: Component Map — Platform API
pages.body_storage:
Platform surface

REST API, Webhooks, Workers, SDK, and Rate Limiting share auth middleware and request IDs. Failures often span two components—treat the map as a dependency graph, not a folder list.

  • Cursor pagination skipping duplicates: NMA-104.
  • Webhook DLQ exhaustion without a final failure event: NMA-105.
  • Rate limiter windows resetting early under clock skew: NMA-106.
  • Edge 429 responses omitting Retry-After: NMA-111.
  • Idempotency keys on create endpoints: NMA-142.

Ship NMA-142 before we advertise at-most-once client retries in public SDK docs. OpenTelemetry around webhook fan-out is NMA-170; PII redaction for worker debug logs is NMA-172.

comments.body_storage: Link the rate-limit tier documentation task NMA-151 when the edge header change ships.
Alex Kim will add the sequence diagram next week.

pages.title: Data Retention Policy
pages.body_storage:
Policy summary

Workspace data is retained for the life of the subscription plus thirty days. Worker job history is partitioned for cold storage; do not invent ad-hoc retention flags in product code.

Support attachment virus scans that never complete for large files are tracked in NMS-120—unscanned blobs must not remain durable beyond twenty-four hours.

PII

Debug logs must follow the redaction policy work in NMA-172 before anyone enables verbose worker logging in production.

  • No credentials in SQLite mirrors or snapshots
  • No customer email in unstructured worker logs
  • Webhook payload samples redacted in support tools

pages.title: Observability Standards
pages.body_storage:
Tracing

Webhook fan-out traces under NMA-170 use the shared trace context. Worker crashes when payloads contain nested null optional fields—see NMA-108—must include job type attributes on the span.

Logs

PII redaction from NMA-172 is mandatory before enabling debug on production workers. Prefer structured fields over free-text concatenation.

Ops dashboard: ops traces. Alert rules live next to the service, not only in this wiki.

pages.title: ADR-001 Workspace Scoping Middleware
pages.body_storage:
Status

Accepted — 2026-06-12

Context

Multi-tenant request contexts were applied inconsistently across board and API routes. That contributed to stale plan tier displays after workspace switches (NMB-110) and seat count mismatches on accounts with more than a thousand seats (NMS-68).

Decision

All authenticated handlers receive a typed workspace scope. Middleware rejects cross-tenant resource IDs before handlers run.

Consequences

  • Board and API share the same scope library
  • SDK tests must send workspace headers on every call
  • Legacy unscoped routes deleted after 2026.7.0

pages.title: ADR-002 Webhook Secret Dual Validation
pages.body_storage:
Status

Accepted — 2026-07-01

Context

Rotating webhook secrets caused verification failures during the grace window. Dual-validation support is NMA-146; related delivery failures that exhaust the DLQ without a final event are NMA-105.

Decision

During rotation, accept either the previous or current secret for thirty minutes and emit dual-validation metrics.

Consequences

The runbook for replaying failed deliveries (NMA-162) must document which secret was active at event time. Grace window length matches the SSO certificate guidance used by support.

comments.body_storage: Thirty-minute grace matches customer IdP cert rotation practice described under NMS-142.

pages.title: ADR-003 Editor CRDT vs OT
pages.body_storage:
Status

Accepted — 2026-05-20

Context

Collaborative cursors jumped to line zero after pastes of five hundred or more lines (NMB-118). Autosave occasionally wrote the previous document revision every third save (NMB-109).

Decision

Stay on operational transformation for 2026.x. Invest in protocol documentation for SDK consumers (NMB-174) rather than a CRDT rewrite this year.

Consequences

Performance budgets for editor initial paint on mid-tier laptops (NMB-181) remain a separate workstream from collab correctness.

pages.title: ADR-004 Rate Limit Header Semantics
pages.body_storage:
Status

Proposed

Context

Edge 429 responses omit Retry-After today (NMA-111). SDK retry middleware already mishandles 503 Retry-After delay values (NMA-123). Rate limiter windows reset early under clock skew between API nodes (NMA-106).

Decision

Standardize X-RateLimit-* plus Retry-After on every 429. Document tiers and header semantics for public consumers under NMA-151.

Consequences

Support needs stable customer-facing language for rate-limit related outages (NMS-151) once headers stop changing week to week.

pages.title: Runbook — Webhook DLQ Replay
pages.body_storage:
When to use

Webhook delivery retries exhaust the DLQ without surfacing a final failure event—that symptom is NMA-105. The longer-term runbook and tooling work is tracked as NMA-162.

Steps

  1. Confirm subscription id and time range in the ops dashboard
  2. List delivery attempts via the public endpoint once NMA-132 ships; until then use admin mirrors
  3. Replay with the secret that was active at event time (see ADR-002 dual validation)
  4. Watch fan-out traces when OpenTelemetry work in NMA-170 is enabled

Rollback

Stop replay jobs if error rate exceeds five percent for ten minutes. Page platform if the DLQ refill rate does not drop after one full cycle.

comments.body_storage: Alex Kim: Tested the dry-run path on staging 2026-07-18.
Add a checklist item for the dual-secret window before the next drill.

pages.title: Runbook — Rate Limit Storm
pages.body_storage:
Symptoms

Spike of 429 responses. Clients without Retry-After thrash the edge—header omission is NMA-111. Windows may also reset early under clock skew (NMA-106).

Mitigations

  1. Check redis clock offset across API nodes
  2. Enable soft warning headers if the experiment flag is available
  3. Point support at the customer language pack in NMS-151
  4. If SDK clients mis-retry on 503, track fixes under NMA-123

Status page template: rate-limit template.

pages.title: Runbook — SSO Certificate Rotation
pages.body_storage:
Scope

Board SSO can fail when the IdP returns a mixed-case NameID domain (NMB-137). Portal-only login breaks are NMS-112. A dedicated verification runbook for agents after cert rotation is requested in NMS-142.

Steps

  1. Load the new IdP cert in staging; force SSO on a test workspace using the admin control from NMB-152
  2. Validate OAuth deep links still land on the board rather than the root dashboard (NMB-122)
  3. Confirm silent token renewal still refreshes session cookies (NMB-107)
  4. Promote to production during low traffic and watch auth error rates for thirty minutes

pages.title: Runbook — Worker Lease Exhaustion
pages.body_storage:
Symptoms

Long-running exports hold a lease until the heartbeat expires (NMA-114). Concurrency semaphores leak slots after a panicked handler (NMA-124). Nested null optional fields in job payloads crash workers (NMA-108).

Immediate actions

  • Drain the export queue and pause new multi-minute jobs
  • Restart worker pods one availability zone at a time
  • Capture payloads that contain nested nulls for the NMA-108 fix set

Progress checkpoints for multi-minute exports are tracked as NMA-135—treat that as a follow-up, not a hot patch during the incident.

pages.title: Runbook — Billing PDF Blank Page
pages.body_storage:
Customer impact

Invoice PDF downloads sometimes include a blank second page (NMB-106). Related billing defects: reverse-charge tax counted twice on line items (NMB-126), portal redirect loops when a session already exists (NMB-117), and receipt email links that open the app root instead of the invoice (NMB-141).

Triage

  1. Reproduce with a reverse-charge workspace versus standard tax
  2. Check PDF renderer version and font pack on the billing worker
  3. If the customer already has a portal session, verify the redirect loop fix path for NMB-117

pages.title: Runbook — Sev-1 Cross-Tenant Display
pages.body_storage:
Trigger

Any report that a customer briefly saw another tenant workspace name on portal load matches NMS-134. Treat as Sev-1 privacy even if the flash lasts under a second.

Actions

  1. Page security and platform on-call immediately
  2. Disable support portal edge cache if the flash correlates with a cache hit
  3. Preserve request ids and edge logs for forensics
  4. Hand customer comms to support using the privacy incident template

Do not close the incident until a root-cause note exists under Postmortems.

pages.title: Local Development Setup
pages.body_storage:
Prerequisites

Install the Nimbus monorepo tooling. Use the demo Atlassian site for integration tests—never point local seeds at production.

  1. Clone the monorepo and run the bootstrap script
  2. Copy .env.example; use example.com hosts only
  3. Start board, API, and worker processes
  4. Import the demo seed dataset for realistic boards

First tickets

Good first bugs: filter chips that reset after switching workspaces (NMB-104), CSV export that truncates multi-line descriptions (NMB-115), or REST returning 500 instead of 422 for invalid due dates (NMA-109).

comments.body_storage: Alex Kim: Add podman notes for Linux contributors.

pages.title: 엔지니어링 온보딩 가이드
pages.body_storage:
환영합니다

Nimbus 엔지니어링 팀에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 문서는 첫 주 체크리스트입니다. 담당 멘토는 Alex Kim입니다.

첫 주에 할 일

  1. 로컬 개발 환경 구성 (Local Development Setup 참고)
  2. 데모 보드에서 필터 칩 이슈 NMB-104 재현해 보기
  3. 대시보드 범례 겹침 버그 NMB-105 스크린샷 첨부 연습
  4. 에디터 자동저장 회귀 NMB-109 관련 테스트 한 개 실행

이슈 키 읽기

NMB는 보드 제품, NMA는 플랫폼 API/SDK, NMS는 지원 포털입니다. 재오픈이 많은 버그—예를 들어 알림 다이제스트 중복 NMB-139—는 수정 범위를 넓게 잡으세요.

내부 링크: 온보딩 포털.

pages.title: How We Ship
pages.body_storage:
Train model

Board releases follow calendar versions 2026.6.0–2026.9.0. Platform SDK uses v2.3–v2.5. Support portal tracks Sprint 41–43.

Definition of done

  • Feature flag default off for risky UI experiments such as compact board density
  • Regression labels set when reopening bugs like the mention spacing fix in NMB-112
  • Docs PR if public API changes—for example rate limit tiers in NMA-151

Never ship billing PDF changes without covering the blank second page case tracked in NMB-106.

pages.title: Security Basics for Engineers
pages.body_storage:
Rules

  • No production credentials in local env files
  • Tenant isolation regressions such as NMS-134 are Sev-1
  • Webhook secrets dual-validate during rotation per NMA-146 and ADR-002
  • CORS allowlist mistakes that reject legitimate example.com subdomains (NMA-120) need security review

Workspace admins forcing SSO for all new invitations is specified under NMB-152; do not invent a one-off flag.

pages.title: Internal Notes — 2026.7.0
pages.body_storage:
Board 2026.7.0

Focus: notifications and editor polish for the mid-year train.

  • Digest emails duplicating near midnight: NMB-139
  • Mention autocomplete inserting an extra space: NMB-112
  • Toasts stacking under the editor toolbar: NMB-108
  • Preferences toggle reverting within two seconds: NMB-120

NMB-112 reopened twice—require golden tests before merge. Follow-ups for 2026.8.0: snooze options in NMB-153 and feed filters in NMB-162.

pages.title: Internal Notes — 2026.8.0
pages.body_storage:
Board 2026.8.0

Dashboard layout readability and billing accuracy for enterprise customers.

  • Chart legend overlap at 1280px: NMB-105
  • Heatmap cells transparent under forced colors: NMB-121
  • Double network on dashboard refresh in Firefox: NMB-129
  • Reverse-charge tax shown twice: NMB-126
  • Upcoming invoice amount on billing settings: NMB-150

Widget drag-and-drop failing on the last row (NMB-142) remains a ship blocker for the dashboard refresh.

comments.body_storage: Coordinate with PROD release comms for customer-facing billing notes.

pages.title: Internal Notes — Platform v2.5
pages.body_storage:
SDK and API v2.5

  • SDK retry middleware ignoring 503 Retry-After: NMA-123
  • createIssue dropping multi-select custom fields: NMA-118
  • Field metadata caching deleted custom fields for a full TTL: NMA-125
  • Edge omitting Retry-After on 429: NMA-111

NMA-118 and NMA-125 both reopened—pair SDK and REST owners for the same patch window. Cursor pagination skipping duplicate sort values (NMA-104) remains open for v2.5.1.

pages.title: Postmortem — Notification Digest Duplicates
pages.body_storage:
Summary

Notification digests duplicated events near the midnight boundary (NMB-139). Preference toggles also reverted if the user navigated away within two seconds (NMB-120).

Impact

Roughly three percent of workspaces spanning UTC midnight saw double emails. Reopen count on the digest bug was two.

Root cause

Digest window bucketing used local timezone while dedupe keys used UTC days.

Actions

  1. Unify digest keys on UTC day boundaries
  2. Add regression tests labeled regression and customer-reported
  3. Audit toast stacking under the editor toolbar covered by NMB-108

comments.body_storage: Alex Kim: Timeline reconstructed from the changelog for NMB-139.
Support reused rate-limit outage language from NMS-151 during the same week—unrelated but co-incident.

pages.title: Postmortem — SDK Retry and Custom Fields
pages.body_storage:
Summary

Two related platform regressions reopened together. SDK retry middleware did not honor 503 Retry-After delays (NMA-123). createIssue dropped multi-select custom field values (NMA-118). The field metadata endpoint also cached deleted custom fields for a full TTL (NMA-125).

Impact

Integrators retried too aggressively during a partial outage; some custom field writes silently dropped.

Actions

  • Honor Retry-After in SDK middleware
  • Invalidate field metadata on delete within sixty seconds
  • Contract tests for multi-select create payloads

pages.title: Postmortem — Support Portal Tenant Flash
pages.body_storage:
Summary

Customers briefly saw another tenant workspace name on portal load (NMS-134). Concurrent agent edits were overwritten by support reply draft autosave (NMS-135).

Severity

Sev-1 security and privacy for the cross-tenant flash; Sev-2 data-loss for drafts.

Actions

  1. Clear cached workspace labels before first paint
  2. Optimistic locking on support reply drafts
  3. Virus scan hangs for large attachments remain separate under NMS-120

pages.title: 장애 포스트모템 — 카드 라벨 오버플로
pages.body_storage:
요약

보드 카드 라벨이 칩 행을 넘칠 때 +N 오버플로 표시가 없어 접근성과 가독성이 깨졌습니다. 추적 이슈는 NMB-140이며 재오픈이 두 번 있었습니다.

영향

고객 신고와 papercut 라벨이 달린 상태였고, 필터 칩이 워크스페이스 전환 후 초기화되는 NMB-104와 같은 스프린트에서 발견되었습니다.

근본 원인

칩 레이아웃이 고정 폭을 가정했고, 다크 모드에서 보조 지표 대비가 WCAG AA를 통과하지 못하던 NMB-111 수정 과정에서 overflow 스타일이 회귀했습니다.

조치

  1. +N 인디케이터 추가 및 시각 회귀 테스트
  2. 멘션 자동완성 공백 이슈 NMB-112와 함께 에디터 칩 컴포넌트 공유
  3. 2026.8.0 릴리스 노트에 papercut 수정 명시

comments.body_storage: Alex Kim: 한국어 전문검색 데모용으로 본문에 이슈 키를 유지했습니다.

pages.title: Eng Sync 2026-07-09
pages.body_storage:
Attendees

Alex Kim plus board and platform rotation.

Notes

  • Ship blocker: last-row widget drag-and-drop failure NMB-142
  • Platform priority: edge Retry-After on 429 under NMA-111
  • Support: workspace invite double-fire on slow connections still flaky—NMS-98

Actions

pages.title: Design Review — Notification Snooze
pages.body_storage:
Proposal

Snooze options for one hour, tomorrow, or next week are tracked in NMB-153. Feed-side filtering by project and event type landed with NMB-162.

Risks

Preference toggles that revert after a quick navigate-away (NMB-120) must be fixed first so snooze state persists. Digest midnight duplication (NMB-139) interacts with snooze windows—reuse UTC day keys from the postmortem.

comments.body_storage: Approved to build behind the notif_snooze_v1 flag.

pages.title: 엔지니어링 주간 회의 2026-07-16
pages.body_storage:
참석

Alex Kim 외 보드/플랫폼 로테이션.

논의

  • 재오픈 버그: SDK 멀티셀렉트 커스텀 필드 누락 NMA-118, 삭제된 필드 메타데이터 캐시 NMA-125
  • 보드: 워크스페이스 전환 후 요금제 티어가 늦게 갱신되는 NMB-110
  • 지원: 환불 정책 매크로가 2025 문구를 넣는 NMS-111

액션

다음 주까지 웹훅 시크릿 이중 검증 ADR 후속과 NMA-146 구현 범위를 맞춘다. 보드 쪽은 NMB-110 재현 로그를 #eng-board에 공유한다.

온콜 인수인계 템플릿에 재오픈 카운트가 있는 이슈를 한 줄로 넣는 규칙을 시험한다.

pages.title: QA — Dashboard Regression Suite
pages.body_storage:
Scope

Dashboard charts, heatmaps, refresh behavior, and filter chips before each board train.

Cases

  1. Filter chips survive workspace switch — NMB-104
  2. Legend overlap at 1280px — NMB-105
  3. Heatmap under forced colors — NMB-121
  4. Refresh button single network flight in Firefox — NMB-129
  5. Widget drag-and-drop on the last row — NMB-142

Pass criteria

No new failures with performance or accessibility labels. Attach screenshots for any visual delta above one pixel on legend layout.

comments.body_storage: Add visual baselines for dark mode secondary metrics covered by NMB-111.

pages.title: QA — Auth and SSO Matrix
pages.body_storage:
Matrix

ScenarioIssueExpect

pages.title: Notification Snooze Spec
pages.body_storage:
User story

As a power user I want to snooze noisy notifications without changing permanent preferences.

Requirements

  1. Snooze durations of one hour, tomorrow, or next week—see NMB-153
  2. Feed filters by project and event type—see NMB-162
  3. Must not regress preference toggle persistence tracked in NMB-120
  4. Digest dedupe remains correct after the midnight fix in NMB-139

Out of scope

Email subject handling for non-ASCII issue titles is a separate workstream.

comments.body_storage: Engineering design review notes live under ENG.
Flag name: notif_snooze_v1

pages.title: Dashboard Layout Spec
pages.body_storage:
Goals

Readable charts at 1280px width (NMB-105), accessible heatmaps under forced colors (NMB-121), and reliable widget reorder including the last row (NMB-142).

Acceptance

  • No double network request on refresh in Firefox — NMB-129
  • Filter chips stable across workspace switches — NMB-104
  • Saved views honor more than the first three selected components — NMB-119

Visual QA attaches before/after captures at 1280 and 1440 widths.

pages.title: Billing Settings Spec
pages.body_storage:
Surfaces

Show the upcoming invoice amount on the billing settings overview (NMB-150). Usage meter must not go negative after a plan downgrade (NMB-134). Receipt email links must open the invoice detail, not the app root (NMB-141).

Invoice PDF and portal

Blank second pages on PDF download (NMB-106) and reverse-charge tax double counting (NMB-126) are P0 for enterprise. Portal redirect loops when a session already exists (NMB-117) block self-serve plan changes.

pages.title: 기능 스펙 — 워크스페이스 전환기
pages.body_storage:
문제

워크스페이스를 전환한 뒤 요금제 티어가 전체 페이지 새로고침 전까지 오래된 값으로 보입니다. 추적 이슈는 NMB-110이며 고객이 빌링 문의를 올리는 주요 원인 중 하나입니다.

요구사항

  1. 전환 직후 plan tier를 재조회한다
  2. 필터 칩이 기본값으로 초기화되지 않아야 한다 — NMB-104
  3. 관리자 SSO 강제 초대 설정 NMB-152와 충돌하지 않을 것

수락 기준

대시보드 범례 겹침 이슈 NMB-105와 같은 2026.8.0 릴리스 열차에서 시각 회귀가 없어야 하며, 전환 후 2초 이내에 티어 표시가 일치해야 한다.

QA는 두 개 이상의 워크스페이스를 가진 데모 계정으로 수동 스모크를 남긴다.

comments.body_storage: 제품/엔지니어링 공동 리뷰 예정.

pages.title: 기능 스펙 — 알림 다이제스트
pages.body_storage:
배경

자정 경계에서 다이제스트 메일이 중복 발송됩니다. 이슈 키는 NMB-139입니다. 또한 환경설정 토글이 2초 안에 다른 화면으로 이동하면 이전 값으로 되돌아가는 회귀가 NMB-120으로 열려 있습니다.

목표

  • UTC 일자 기준 중복 제거
  • 스누즈 NMB-153과 피드 필터 NMB-162와 일관된 상태 모델
  • 알림 토스트가 에디터 고정 툴바 뒤에 가려지지 않을 것 — NMB-108

제품 노트: notif digest.

ENG 포스트모템 문서를 함께 읽고 타임존 버킷 실수를 반복하지 말 것.

pages.title: Workspace Admin Controls Brief
pages.body_storage:
Problem

Admins cannot force SSO for all new member invitations. Security-conscious customers escalate through support when invites bypass corporate IdP.

Proposal

Ship the admin toggle described in NMB-152. Coordinate with portal-only SSO failures in NMS-112 and the certificate rotation verification path in NMS-142.

Success metrics

Fewer seat and security tickets such as seat count mismatches on large accounts tracked in NMS-68.

pages.title: 제품 브리프 — CSV 내보내기 한도
pages.body_storage:
문제 진술

보드 CSV 내보내기에서 여러 줄 설명 필드가 255자에서 잘립니다. 관련 이슈는 NMB-115입니다. 지원 포털 쪽 내보내기는 느린 연결에서 이중 실행되는 문제가 NMS-59로 열려 있습니다.

가설

셀 한도를 올리고 스트리밍 내보내기로 전환하면 고객 신고가 줄어든다. 장시간 작업의 워커 하트비트 만료 이슈 NMA-114와 함께 설계를 검토한다.

다음 단계

보드 CSV와 지원 내보내기 픽스처를 공유해 회귀를 한 번에 잡는다. ENG ADR의 8 KiB 소프트 한도 제안을 스펙으로 승격할지 로드맵 리뷰에서 결정한다.

pages.title: API Platform Brief — Idempotency
pages.body_storage:
Why now

Integrators retry creates aggressively. Without idempotency keys on create endpoints (NMA-142) those retries produce duplicate records.

Related defects

  • SDK 503 Retry-After handling — NMA-123
  • Multi-select custom fields dropped on create — NMA-118
  • Stale deleted field metadata — NMA-125

Document rate limit tiers and header semantics (NMA-151) in the same education push so integrators stop guessing.

pages.title: 제품 회의록 — 2026년 7월 로드맵
pages.body_storage:
안건

H2 테마 확정과 재오픈 버그 처리 원칙을 이번 회의에서 닫는다. 참석: 제품, 엔지니어링 로테이션, 지원 대표.

결정

  • 알림 다이제스트 중복 NMB-139를 P0로 유지
  • 카드 라벨 오버플로 NMB-140은 papercut이지만 접근성 영향으로 승격
  • 지원 포털 테넌트 이름 플래시 NMS-134는 보안 분류로 처리

후속

엔지니어링 온보딩 한국어 가이드와 연동해 신규 입사자가 NMB-104 재현부터 하도록 안내한다. 다음 로드맵 리뷰 전에 CSAT 내보내기 NMS-143 초안 수치를 붙인다.

pages.title: 제품 회의록 — 빌링 품질
pages.body_storage:
요약

PDF 빈 페이지 NMB-106, 세금 이중 계산 NMB-126, 포털 리다이렉트 루프 NMB-117, 영수증 링크 오류 NMB-141을 하나의 빌링 품질 에픽으로 묶는다.

지원 측 통화 계측 이슈 NMS-50은 제품 버그와 티켓 유형을 분리한다. 계측 노이즈가 실제 인보이스 결함 트리아지를 늦춘 이력이 있다.

일정

2026.8.0 고객 릴리스 노트 문구와 맞춰 같은 열차에 태운다. 법률 리뷰는 세금 관련 문장만 별도 통과 확인한다. 완료 후 ENG 내부 노트와 이슈 키를 교차 점검한다.

pages.title: Research — Notification Fatigue
pages.body_storage:
Themes

Users request snooze controls and better digests. Evidence aligns with snooze work in NMB-153, feed filters in NMB-162, and the midnight duplication fix in NMB-139.

Preference UI trust is low after toggles revert on quick navigation (NMB-120). Several CSAT comments mentioned turning notifications off entirely rather than tuning them.

pages.title: Research — Billing Confusion
pages.body_storage:
Themes

PDF quality and tax line items drive enterprise tickets—see NMB-106 and NMB-126. Seat count mismatches on large accounts (NMS-68) confuse workspace admins during renewals.

Upcoming invoice transparency on settings (NMB-150) is the most requested billing change in the last two CSAT waves.

pages.title: Research — Integrator Pain Points
pages.body_storage:
Themes

SDK retries and custom fields (NMA-123, NMA-118), pagination edge cases (NMA-104), and webhook DLQ opacity (NMA-105) dominate integrator forum threads.

Requests for documented rate limit tiers (NMA-151) appear nearly every week. Share this note with ENG architecture owners before the next platform briefing.

comments.body_storage: Share with ENG architecture owners.
